about.first_paragraph: Carefully renovated and decorated, the house harmoniously blends vintage furniture, family keepsakes and contemporary touches, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere.
about.second_paragraph: It offers three suites designed for everyone's comfort: two beautiful double bedrooms nestled under the eaves on the second floor, and a spacious family suite on the first floor that can sleep up to six people. All of them enjoy a pleasant view over the garden.
about.third_paragraph: Located on the edge of the village of Saint-Savinien, just 1.5 km from the center, the house invites you to enjoy a peaceful stay, combining old-world charm with a relaxed way of life.

first_card.title: Breakfast crafted with love
first_card.description: Enjoy a delicious breakfast made with care, featuring local and seasonal products, fresh bread, homemade yogurt, and jams.

second_card.title: Restful sleep
second_card.description: Enjoy an unparalleled night’s sleep with our premium high-quality cotton sheets. They ensure optimal comfort for a restful night.

third_card.title: Serenity in the garden
third_card.description: Discover numerous relaxing spots throughout the garden. Sunny or shaded terraces, perfect for outdoor meals or moments of reading.
